name: change_strategic_resource
description: Add or remove units of a stockpiled strategic resource (Iron, Horses, Niter, Coal, Oil, Aluminum, Uranium) for a player via Player:GetResources():ChangeResourceAmount in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/Player.ltp '+10 Iron'). Params: resource (RESOURCE_* type, required), amount (required; negative to remove), playerId (default local player). Returns before/after stockpile from GetResourceAmount. Note: the stockpile cap still applies at turn processing.
lua:
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then pid = Game.GetLocalPlayer() end
local alive = false
for _, id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if id == pid then alive = true end end
if not alive then emitJson({ok=false, error="player "..tostring(pid).." is not alive"}) return end
local info = GameInfo.Resources[P.resource]
if info == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="unknown resource "..tostring(P.resource)}) return end
local amt = tonumber(P.amount)
if amt == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="amount must be a number"}) return end
local r = Players[pid]:GetResources()
local before = r:GetResourceAmount(info.Index)
r:ChangeResourceAmount(info.Index, amt)
local after = r:GetResourceAmount(info.Index)
emitJson({ok=true, playerId=pid, resource=info.ResourceType, resourceClass=info.ResourceClassType, before=before, after=after})
